title: Wine Cellar Inventory and Drink-By Window
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=winecellar:reading event=inventory
| stats latest(bottles) as bottles, latest(drink_by_year) as drink_by by wine
| eval years_left=drink_by-strftime(now(),"%Y")
| sort years_left
| head 20
description: Lists your cellared wines by how many years remain in their ideal drinking window so none is forgotten past its prime.
value: A collection is wasted if bottles slip past their peak unnoticed; a drink-by ranking makes sure the right bottle is opened in time.
implementation: Record bottle counts and drinking windows; schedule monthly and surface wines nearing the end of their window.
visualization: Table of wines sorted by years left in the drinking window.
grandmaExplanation: It lists your wine and how long each bottle should be kept, so you drink them at their best instead of too late.
